So you go alone, and I send no escort. Do not name the Reed in Helstrom. If it is named, what you saw becomes the Reed's word and I cannot disown it. I do not like using a hand I can disown. I have no other. Take the coast ship at Lilmoth's stop, on the east side of the town. The ship has a door that opens on Helstrom's landing. Go ashore by it. From the landing the way runs inland over roots and through shallows. Two giant wasps keep the far bend of it, short of the gate. Just inside the gate, to the west, is the grove. Ei-Tuja stands there, a Nisswo who reads for anyone. Kaska-Meen is a tree-minder who sits in the city's assembly and keeps the grove's watch, and she hears few strangers. Whoever you tell decides how the word travels. A Nisswo preaches it in every village, where the cutters will hear it too. A tree-minder carries it only to those who keep trees. Go and tell one of them what you saw. Say only that, as a stranger who saw it."
